case_number.intent: The client's agency case number, as read or confirmed in the session. Format AB-000000.

client_first_name.intent: The client's legal first name, as the client states it.

client_last_name.intent: The client's legal last name, as the client states it.

client_preferred_name.intent: The name the client says they prefer to be called, if different from the legal name.

client_dob.intent: The client's date of birth as the client states it.

pronouns.intent: The pronouns the client says they use. Only if the client states them.

option_semantics.NOT_ASKED: never use: absence is left blank, not recorded

gender_identity.intent: The client's gender identity, only if the client explicitly states it. Never inferred from pronouns, name, or voice.

option_semantics.WOMAN: client explicitly says they identify as a woman; never inferred from she/her pronouns
option_semantics.MAN: client explicitly says he identifies as a man; never inferred from he/him pronouns
option_semantics.DECLINED: client was asked and declined to answer

contact_phone.intent: The client's own primary phone number, as the client states it (not a relative's).

contact_email.intent: The client's own email address, as the client states it.

contact_ok_voicemail.intent: Whether the client agrees the agency may leave voicemail at the client's number.

option_semantics.YES: client agrees voicemail may be left
option_semantics.NO: client says not to leave voicemail

address_line.intent: The client's street address (number, street, unit). Use the complete version if it was repeated after a cut-off.

address_city.intent: The city of the client's address.

address_zip.intent: The ZIP code of the client's address.

language_combo.intent: The language the CLIENT prefers for sessions. A relative's language is not the client's.

option_semantics.SPANISH: the client themself prefers Spanish; a family member speaking Spanish does not count

interpreter_needed.intent: Whether the CLIENT needs an interpreter for sessions. A relative needing one does not count.

option_semantics.YES: client needs an interpreter for sessions
option_semantics.NO: client says no interpreter is needed

session_date.intent: Date of the session. Supplied by the app from session metadata, not extracted from the transcript.

session_modality.intent: Video, phone or in person. Supplied by the app from session metadata, not extracted from the transcript.

f_f79934c38a.intent: Session length in minutes (the control with no id or name; its key is the profiler's hash fallback). Supplied by the app from session metadata.

session_type.intent: Whether this session is an intake, a follow-up, or a crisis contact, as stated in the session (usually by the worker).

option_semantics.FOLLOW_UP: a continuing session with an existing client

referral_source.intent: Who referred the client to the agency, as the client states it.

option_semantics.SELF: client found the agency on their own
option_semantics.SCHOOL: a school or school counselor (including the client's child's school) referred the client
option_semantics.PCP: the client's primary care provider referred

insurance_type.intent: The client's health coverage, as the client states it.

option_semantics.UNINSURED: client says they have no coverage
option_semantics.UNKNOWN: client says they do not know their coverage

insurance_member_id.intent: The client's insurance member ID (the number on their Medi-Cal/insurance card), only if the client states it. Never the agency case number (AB-000000 format): that belongs to a different field.

emergency_contact_name.intent: Full name of the person the client names as emergency contact.

emergency_contact_phone.intent: Phone number of the client's emergency contact.

emergency_contact_relationship.intent: The emergency contact's relationship to the client.

consent_telehealth.intent: How the client consented to telehealth for this session. Usually the worker asks and the client agrees aloud.

option_semantics.VERBAL: client gave spoken consent in the session
option_semantics.WRITTEN: a signed written consent is stated to be on file

release_of_info.intent: Releases of information the client has actually signed and that are on file. A hypothetical ('I would need your permission') is not a release. Leave blank unless releases were reviewed.

option_semantics.PCP: a signed release for the primary care provider is on file
option_semantics.PSYCHIATRIST: a signed release for a psychiatrist is on file
option_semantics.SCHOOL: a signed release for the school is on file; talk of needing permission is not a release
option_semantics.FAMILY: a signed release for a family member is on file
option_semantics.NONE: releases were reviewed and the client has none; never use because none were mentioned

phq9_1.intent: PHQ-9 item 1 (Little interest or pleasure in doing things): the frequency the CLIENT gives for this item over the last two weeks, when the worker administers it. Only this item's answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

phq9_2.intent: PHQ-9 item 2 (Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless): the frequency the CLIENT gives for this item over the last two weeks, when the worker administers it. Only this item's answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

phq9_3.intent: PHQ-9 item 3 (Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much): the frequency the CLIENT gives for this item over the last two weeks, when the worker administers it. Only this item's answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

phq9_4.intent: PHQ-9 item 4 (Feeling tired or having little energy): the frequency the CLIENT gives for this item over the last two weeks, when the worker administers it. Only this item's answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

phq9_5.intent: PHQ-9 item 5 (Poor appetite or overeating (appetite itself, not skipping meals for lack of money or food)): the frequency the CLIENT gives for this item over the last two weeks, when the worker administers it. Only this item's answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

phq9_6.intent: PHQ-9 item 6 (Feeling bad about yourself, or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down): the frequency the CLIENT gives for this item over the last two weeks, when the worker administers it. Only this item's answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

phq9_7.intent: PHQ-9 item 7 (Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television): the frequency the CLIENT gives for this item over the last two weeks, when the worker administers it. Only this item's answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

phq9_8.intent: PHQ-9 item 8 (Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed, or the opposite: being so fidgety or restless): the frequency the CLIENT gives for this item over the last two weeks, when the worker administers it. Only this item's answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

phq9_9.intent: PHQ-9 item 9 (Thoughts that you would be better off dead, or of hurting yourself in some way): the frequency the CLIENT gives for this item over the last two weeks, when the worker administers it. Only this item's answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

phq9_difficulty.intent: PHQ-9 final question: how difficult the client says these problems have made work, home, or getting along with people.

phq9_score.intent: PHQ-9 total, computed in code from the nine items.

phq9_severity.intent: PHQ-9 severity band, computed in code from the nine items.

gad7_status.intent: Whether the GAD-7 anxiety questionnaire was administered this session, as the worker states it.

option_semantics.COMPLETED: all seven GAD-7 questions were asked and answered this session
option_semantics.DEFERRED: the worker postponed the anxiety questionnaire to a later session
option_semantics.NOT_INDICATED: the worker says it is not needed

gad7_1.intent: GAD-7 item 1 (Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge): only the frequency the client gives when the worker actually asks this GAD-7 item. General worry talk outside the questionnaire is not an answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

gad7_2.intent: GAD-7 item 2 (Not being able to stop or control worrying): only the frequency the client gives when the worker actually asks this GAD-7 item. General worry talk outside the questionnaire is not an answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

gad7_3.intent: GAD-7 item 3 (Worrying too much about different things): only the frequency the client gives when the worker actually asks this GAD-7 item. General worry talk outside the questionnaire is not an answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

gad7_4.intent: GAD-7 item 4 (Trouble relaxing): only the frequency the client gives when the worker actually asks this GAD-7 item. General worry talk outside the questionnaire is not an answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

gad7_5.intent: GAD-7 item 5 (Being so restless that it is hard to sit still): only the frequency the client gives when the worker actually asks this GAD-7 item. General worry talk outside the questionnaire is not an answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

gad7_6.intent: GAD-7 item 6 (Becoming easily annoyed or irritable): only the frequency the client gives when the worker actually asks this GAD-7 item. General worry talk outside the questionnaire is not an answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

gad7_7.intent: GAD-7 item 7 (Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen): only the frequency the client gives when the worker actually asks this GAD-7 item. General worry talk outside the questionnaire is not an answer.

option_semantics.0: Negative: not at all bothered by this item

gad7_score.intent: GAD-7 total, computed in code from the seven items.

gad7_severity.intent: GAD-7 severity band, computed in code from the seven items.

si_ideation.intent: Whether the client reported suicidal ideation, and its form, in the client's own words.

option_semantics.NONE: Negative: client denies any thoughts of death or suicide
option_semantics.PASSIVE: wishes to be dead, not wake up, or that others would be better off, with no intent or plan
option_semantics.ACTIVE_NO_PLAN: thoughts of killing oneself, without a plan
option_semantics.ACTIVE_WITH_PLAN: thoughts of killing oneself with a described plan

si_frequency.intent: How often the client says suicidal thoughts occurred over the past two weeks.

option_semantics.NONE: Negative: client reports no such thoughts in the past two weeks

si_plan.intent: Whether the client has a suicide plan, as the client answers when asked.

option_semantics.NO: Negative: client denies having a plan
option_semantics.YES: client describes or admits a plan
option_semantics.NOT_ASSESSED: never use: if not asked, leave blank

si_intent.intent: Whether the client intends to act on suicidal thoughts, as the client answers when asked.

option_semantics.NOT_ASSESSED: never use: if not asked, leave blank

si_means.intent: Whether the client has access to lethal means (firearms, stockpiled medication, etc.), only if explicitly asked and answered. A prescription or a question about drug use is not an answer about means.

option_semantics.NO_ACCESS: client explicitly says they have no access to firearms, stockpiled medications or other lethal means
option_semantics.HAS_ACCESS: client explicitly says they have access to firearms, stockpiled medications or other lethal means
option_semantics.NOT_ASSESSED: never use: if means were not discussed, leave blank

si_prior_attempts.intent: Whether the client has ever attempted suicide, as the client answers.

option_semantics.NONE: Negative: client denies any prior attempt
option_semantics.UNKNOWN: client says they do not know or will not say

hi_ideation.intent: Whether the client reported thoughts of harming others.

option_semantics.NONE: Negative: client denies thoughts of hurting anyone else
option_semantics.PASSIVE: vague or passive thoughts of others being harmed, no intent
option_semantics.ACTIVE: thoughts of harming a specific person

hi_plan.intent: Whether the client has a plan to harm someone else, only if asked.

option_semantics.NO: Negative: client explicitly denies a plan to harm others
option_semantics.YES: client describes a plan to harm others
option_semantics.NOT_ASSESSED: never use: if not asked, leave blank

safety_plan.intent: What was done with a suicide safety plan this session, as stated in the session (usually by the worker).

option_semantics.COMPLETED: a new safety plan was written together in this session
option_semantics.UPDATED: an existing safety plan was changed
option_semantics.REVIEWED: an existing safety plan was reviewed without changes
option_semantics.DECLINED: the client declined a safety plan
option_semantics.NOT_INDICATED: the worker says no safety plan is needed

risk_narrative.intent: Factual summary of the suicide and violence risk inquiry: what was asked and what the client answered (ideation, frequency, plan, intent, prior attempts, homicidal ideation, safety plan, crisis resources). Never state an overall risk level, never mention lethal means unless discussed.

risk_level.intent: The clinician's overall risk determination. Clinical judgement: never extracted.

protective_factors.intent: Protective factors against suicide that the client describes.

option_semantics.CHILDREN_IN_HOME: client's children at home, or responsibility for a child as a reason to live
option_semantics.FUTURE_ORIENTATION: client describes goals or plans for the future
option_semantics.RELIGIOUS_BELIEFS: client describes their own faith as a support; declining church does not count

crisis_resources.intent: Crisis resources the worker actually gave the client this session.

option_semantics.LINE_988: the 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline was given
option_semantics.COUNTY_CRISIS: the county crisis line was given
option_semantics.MOBILE_CRISIS: the mobile crisis team was given
option_semantics.NONE: worker states no crisis resources were given; never use because none were mentioned

supervisor_consult.intent: Whether the worker consulted a supervisor. Worker's own record: never extracted.

presenting_problem.intent: What brought the client in: the reasons for reaching out and the current problems, in the client's account.

psychosocial_history.intent: Household, family and social supports, education, work history, income and benefits, as the client describes them. Applied-for benefits are pending, not received.

interventions.intent: What the worker did in this session (assessments administered, safety planning, psychoeducation, referrals, supportive techniques). Only what was actually done.

plan.intent: Next steps agreed in this session: referrals, client tasks, follow-up schedule, deferred items.

client_strengths.intent: Strengths the client shows or describes (e.g. persistence, organization, supports, help-seeking).

option_semantics.STABLE: housed with no threat to the housing
option_semantics.AT_RISK: housed but behind on rent, has a notice, or fears losing housing
option_semantics.DOUBLED_UP: staying with others because they lost housing
option_semantics.UNSHELTERED: currently sleeping outside or in a car; a feared future loss does not count

option_semantics.WITH_FAMILY: client lives with family members, including their own children

option_semantics.UNEMPLOYED: not working and looking for work, e.g. laid off

income_sources.intent: Income the client is currently receiving. Applied-for or pending benefits are not income.

option_semantics.SNAP: currently receiving CalFresh/SNAP benefits; applied or pending does not count
option_semantics.NONE: client says they have no income at all

food_security.intent: Whether the client's household has enough food.

option_semantics.SECURE: client says they reliably have enough food
option_semantics.INSECURE: client skips meals, runs out of food, or cannot afford enough food

transportation.intent: The client's access to transportation, only if discussed.

option_semantics.NONE: Negative: client says they have no transportation

legal_involvement.intent: Current legal involvement of the client (probation, court cases, CPS), only if discussed. A landlord's notice is not a court case.

option_semantics.NONE: Negative: client explicitly says there is no legal involvement
option_semantics.PENDING_CASE: a court case is filed and pending; a landlord's pay-or-quit notice is not a case

children_in_home.intent: Whether minor children live in the client's home.

option_semantics.YES: client's household includes a child under 18
option_semantics.NO: Negative: no minor children live in the home

substances.intent: Substances the CLIENT reports using in the past 30 days. Substances named only in the worker's questions and denied by the client are not reported.

option_semantics.ALCOHOL: client reports drinking alcohol in the past month
option_semantics.CANNABIS: client reports using cannabis; a worker asking about cannabis is not a report
option_semantics.OPIOIDS: client reports using opioids or pain pills; a worker asking about them is not a report
option_semantics.NONE_REPORTED: client denies all substance use, including alcohol

alcohol_frequency.intent: How often the client says they drink alcohol. Work out drinking occasions per MONTH first (a month has about 4 weeks), then pick the band; don't confuse 'times a month' with 'times a week'.

option_semantics.TWO_TO_FOUR_PER_MONTH: two to four times a month
option_semantics.TWO_TO_THREE_PER_WEEK: two to three times a week
option_semantics.FOUR_PLUS_PER_WEEK: four or more times a week

tobacco_use.intent: The client's tobacco or nicotine use.

option_semantics.NEVER: Negative: client never used tobacco or nicotine
option_semantics.FORMER: client used to smoke or vape and has quit

substance_tx_history.intent: Prior substance-use treatment the client describes, only if discussed.

option_semantics.NONE: Negative: client says they never had substance-use treatment

pcp_name.intent: The client's primary care provider (name, and clinic if given).

current_medications.intent: Medications prescribed to the client, with dose, as the client states them (including ones they have stopped taking but is prescribed).

medication_adherence.intent: Whether the client is taking prescribed medications as prescribed.

option_semantics.PARTIAL: taking it sometimes or missing doses
option_semantics.NOT_TAKING: prescribed but has stopped or run out and is not taking it

sleep_hours.intent: Typical hours of sleep per night as the client reports it (e.g. "4-5" or "about five"). Only if stated.

support_system.intent: People and groups the client describes as supporting them now.

option_semantics.FAMILY: family members who help or support the client
option_semantics.FAITH_COMMUNITY: a faith community the client is part of; being urged to go to church does not count
option_semantics.PEER_GROUP: a peer or support group the client attends
option_semantics.NONE: client says they have no support

mse_appearance.intent: Mental status: appearance. Clinical observation, never extracted.

mse_mood.intent: The client's mood in the client's own words, when asked to describe it.

mse_affect.intent: Mental status: affect. Clinical observation, never extracted.

mse_thought_process.intent: Mental status: thought process. Clinical observation, never extracted.

mse_orientation.intent: Mental status: orientation. Clinical observation, never extracted.

mse_insight.intent: Mental status: insight. Clinical judgement, never extracted.

mse_judgment.intent: Mental status: judgment. Clinical judgement, never extracted.

adl_bathing.intent: Functional assessment of the client's ability with bathing, only if the worker assesses it and the client answers.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: client explicitly says they do this without help
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: client says they need some help with this
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: client says someone else does this for them
option_semantics.NOT_ASSESSED: never use: if not asked, leave blank

adl_dressing.intent: Functional assessment of the client's ability with dressing, only if the worker assesses it and the client answers.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: client explicitly says they do this without help
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: client says they need some help with this
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: client says someone else does this for them
option_semantics.NOT_ASSESSED: never use: if not asked, leave blank

adl_eating.intent: Functional assessment of the client's ability with eating (the physical ability to feed oneself; not food supply or appetite), only if the worker assesses it and the client answers.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: client explicitly says they do this without help
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: client says they need some help with this
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: client says someone else does this for them
option_semantics.NOT_ASSESSED: never use: if not asked, leave blank

adl_mobility.intent: Functional assessment of the client's ability with mobility, only if the worker assesses it and the client answers.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: client explicitly says they do this without help
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: client says they need some help with this
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: client says someone else does this for them
option_semantics.NOT_ASSESSED: never use: if not asked, leave blank

iadl_finances.intent: Functional assessment of the client's ability with managing finances (the functional ability; not lack of money), only if the worker assesses it and the client answers.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: client explicitly says they do this without help
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: client says they need some help with this
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: client says someone else does this for them
option_semantics.NOT_ASSESSED: never use: if not asked, leave blank

iadl_transport.intent: Functional assessment of the client's ability with arranging transportation, only if the worker assesses it and the client answers.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: client explicitly says they do this without help
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: client says they need some help with this
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: client says someone else does this for them
option_semantics.NOT_ASSESSED: never use: if not asked, leave blank

iadl_medications.intent: Functional assessment of the client's ability with managing medications (the functional ability; not running out of a refill), only if the worker assesses it and the client answers.

option_semantics.INDEPENDENT: client explicitly says they do this without help
option_semantics.NEEDS_ASSISTANCE: client says they need some help with this
option_semantics.DEPENDENT: client says someone else does this for them
option_semantics.NOT_ASSESSED: never use: if not asked, leave blank

referrals_made.intent: Referrals the worker actually made this session. Something to 'revisit later' is not a referral.

option_semantics.FOOD_BANK: referred to a food bank or pantry
option_semantics.HOUSING_NAV: referred to housing navigation or rental assistance
option_semantics.BENEFITS: referred to a benefits team or for help with benefit applications
option_semantics.PSYCHIATRY: an actual psychiatry referral was made; 'we can revisit' does not count
option_semantics.NONE: worker states no referrals were made

client_goal.intent: The client's goal, in the client's own words.

next_appointment.intent: The date of the next scheduled appointment, resolved against the session date (YYYY-MM-DD).

follow_up_interval.intent: How often sessions will happen going forward, as agreed in the session.

level_of_care.intent: Recommended level of care. Clinical judgement: never extracted.

diagnosis_impression.intent: Diagnostic impression. Clinical judgement: never extracted.

note_attestation.intent: The worker's attestation. Must be checked by the worker personally: never extracted.

name: Riverside County HSA — Integrated Client Record
